name: btf-migration
description: BikeTourFrance website: native Astro build deployed to Cloudflare Pages (project temp-btf) from GitHub.

scripts.dev: npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && astro dev
scripts.build: npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && astro build && npm run copy:verify-rendered && npm run verify
scripts.predeploy: BTF_DEPLOY_ENV=production npm run build && node scripts/copy/assert-deployable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:fixture && npm run copy:test && npm run check
